mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap s ON s.strategy_id = f.strategy_id AND s.tab_type = f.tab_type AND DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = #{statMonth} AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = f.channel

LEFT JOIN t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s ON s.strategy_id = f.strategy_id AND DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = #{statMonth} AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = f.channel

choose.when:
SELECT f.id AS id, f.strategy_id AS strategyId, f.strategy_name AS strategyName, f.channel AS channel, d.key_name AS channelName, DATE_FORMAT(f.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS favTime, f.source AS source, s.consult_count AS consultCount, s.consult_count_qoq AS consultCountQoQ, s.retain_count AS retainCount, s.retain_count_qoq AS retainCountQoQ, s.retain_rate AS retainRate, s.retain_rate_qoq AS retainRateQoQ, s.dispatch_count AS dispatchCount, s.dispatch_count_qoq AS dispatchCountQoQ, s.success_count AS successCount, s.success_count_qoq AS successCountQoQ, s.success_rate AS successRate, s.success_rate_qoq AS successRateQoQ, s.income AS income, s.income_qoq AS incomeQoQ, DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statMonth FROM t_sr_favorite f
WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.tab_type = #{tabType} AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT f.id AS id, f.strategy_id AS strategyId, f.strategy_name AS strategyName, f.channel AS channel, d.key_name AS channelName, DATE_FORMAT(f.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS favTime, f.source AS source, s.original_cust AS originalCust, s.original_cust_qoq AS originalCustQoQ, s.push_count AS pushCount, s.push_count_qoq AS pushCountQoQ, s.usage_count AS usageCount, s.usage_count_qoq AS usageCountQoQ, s.usage_rate AS usageRate, s.usage_rate_qoq AS usageRateQoQ, s.reach_count AS reachCount, s.reach_count_qoq AS reachCountQoQ, s.target_conv_num AS targetConvNum, s.target_conv_num_qoq AS targetConvNumQoQ, s.target_conv_rate AS targetConvRate, s.target_conv_rate_qoq AS targetConvRateQoQ, s.product_conv_num AS productConvNum, s.product_conv_num_qoq AS productConvNumQoQ, s.product_conv_rate AS productConvRate, s.product_conv_rate_qoq AS productConvRateQoQ, s.expected_income AS expectedIncome, s.expected_income_qoq AS expectedIncomeQoQ, s.actual_income AS actualIncome, s.actual_income_qoq AS actualIncomeQoQ, DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statMonth FROM t_sr_favorite f
WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.tab_type = #{tabType} AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sr_favorite (user_id, tab_type, strategy_id, strategy_name, channel, rule_id, source, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tabType}, #{strategyId}, #{strategyName}, #{channel}, #{ruleId}, #{source}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
